title: Many-Shot Context Flooding: Which Causal Step Drives Attack Success?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Pinpointing the dominant causal step directly informs the cheapest mitigation. If count is dominant, truncation suffices; if per-shot harmfulness matters, content filtering is the right intervention. Compelling chain from ablation to actionable defense.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Creating controlled ablations (vary length/count/harmfulness independently) and measuring ASR on JailbreakBench is well within beginner capabilities. Uses Llama-3-8B with standard evaluation tools. No activation extraction needed.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clean ablation study with three controlled variables. Each ablation is a simple experimental condition. JailbreakBench provides structure. 20 hours as stated is realistic. Clear single deliverable: which causal factor dominates.
